title: DEFINE slice 1: delta module and freeze record I/O
summary: Ship src/query/delta.js (hashDocument, computeTreeHash, computeDelta) and src/define/freeze-record.js (load, save, validate). Export the delta primitives from src/query/index.js. Cover every AC with unit tests in test/query/delta.test.js and test/define/freeze-record.test.js.
approach: Pure module with SHA-256 over canonical JSON per proposal 2026-09-22 v3 section 2.1 / 2.2. Canonicalise recurses over the parsed value, sorting object keys and stripping whitespace. Tree hash is SHA-256 over the sorted (id, docHash) pairs. Delta enumerates tree.byId once and classifies each id against the freeze docHashes, appending ledger:<name> entries for the sidecars the caller passes. Freeze record I/O treats a missing file as null; a malformed body raises FreezeRecordError with a coded reason and a named field. The writer validates first so a bad in-memory record never lands on disk.
deliverables: src/query/delta.js: canonicaliseJson, hashDocument, computeTreeHash, computeDelta (§2.2 shape)
src/query/index.js: re-export the four delta primitives
src/define/freeze-record.js: FREEZE_RECORD_REL_PATH, FreezeRecordError, validateFreezeRecord, loadFreezeRecord, saveFreezeRecord
test/query/delta.test.js: eleven tests covering AC-17201-1 and AC-17201-2
test/define/freeze-record.test.js: nine tests covering AC-17201-3 and AC-17201-4
notes: Pure module: no filesystem I/O beyond the freeze reader / writer. computeDelta signature and return shape are the contract every later slice reads.
